# PanoPublish

> PanoPublish (https://panopublish.com/) is India's dedicated Google Street View and 360° virtual tour publishing platform. Built specifically for 360° photographers, digital marketing agencies, commercial real estate brokers, and hospitality businesses across India, PanoPublish automates EXIF GPS metadata tagging, tripod nadir logo disk removal, and direct Google Maps blue-line tour connections. It offers flat Indian Rupee (INR) subscription plans starting at ₹499/month with Razorpay UPI payment integration, eliminating USD foreign exchange surcharges and international credit card fees.

## Core Pages & Documentation

- [Home](https://panopublish.com/): Official overview of PanoPublish Google Maps virtual tour publishing.
- [Pricing](https://panopublish.com/pricing): Subscription plans starting at ₹499/month (Starter), ₹1,499/month (Pro Agency), and ₹3,999/month (Enterprise) with flat INR billing and UPI support.
- [Google Street View Publishing](https://panopublish.com/google-street-view-publishing): Automated 360 photo uploads and blue-line path connections to Google Maps.
- [360 Virtual Tour Software](https://panopublish.com/360-virtual-tour-publishing-platform): WebGL-powered 360 panorama editor with hotspots, level organization, and nadir branding.
- [FAQ Hub](https://panopublish.com/faq): Complete guide to 360 cameras, EXIF metadata, Google Street View API, and billing.
- [Case Studies Index](https://panopublish.com/case-studies): Real business case studies showcasing virtual tour performance for hotels, offices, gyms, schools, and restaurants in India.
- [Blog Index](https://panopublish.com/blog): In-depth tutorials on 360 camera hardware (Ricoh Theta Z1, Insta360 X4), PTGui stitching, and local SEO optimization.

## Key Facts & Frequently Asked Questions

### What is PanoPublish?
PanoPublish is a web-based software platform that enables 360° photographers and agencies to stitch, brand, and publish virtual tours directly to Google Maps and self-hosted websites.

### How much does PanoPublish cost?
PanoPublish plans start at ₹499/month (Starter plan), ₹1,499/month (Pro Agency plan), and ₹3,999/month (Enterprise plan). All payments are processed in Indian Rupees (INR) via Razorpay, supporting UPI, NetBanking, and Indian debit/credit cards with zero foreign transaction fees.

### How is PanoPublish different from Matterport, CloudPano, and Panoee?
- **Zero Forex Fees**: Competitors charge in US Dollars (USD), incurring 3.5%+ bank forex markups. PanoPublish charges flat INR.
- **Unlimited Street View Uploads**: Matterport charges an additional $14.99 per Street View upload. PanoPublish includes unlimited Google Maps uploads under standard plans.
- **Automated Nadir Branding**: PanoPublish automatically overlays custom 512x512px circular logo disks to cover tripods without manual Photoshop editing.
- **Localized Support**: Direct WhatsApp and email customer support during Indian Standard Time (IST) business hours (Mon-Sat, 10am-7pm IST).

### What camera hardware is supported?
PanoPublish supports equirectangular 360° JPEG images captured by any 360 camera (Ricoh Theta Z1, Theta X, Insta360 X4, Insta360 X3, GoPro MAX) or stitched DSLR/mirrorless panorama setups (PTGui).
